description: GeoConnectGR: lakes and reservoirs is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. Final product of the b-solutions project GeoConnectGR - Harmonized geodata of the hydrographic network of the Greater Region (scale 1:25,000 - 1:50,000)- Sources: LVGL Saarland, LVermGeo Rheinland-Pfalz, NGI Belgium, IGN France, ACT Luxembourg - Harmonization: Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG) based on the data model Core Reference Data (CRD) developed by EuroGeographics This ... Coverage: SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. The publisher named on the listing is SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. Its keywords include lake, reservoir, water, environment, hydrographic-network. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other-at. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
